en: A sepia-toned studio photograph of a man standing in full traditional Ottoman/Turkish costume. He wears a fez, a short embroidered vest over a light shirt, a wide decorated sash around his waist, and patterned trousers tucked into footwear. The backdrop is painted with floral and natural motifs. At the top of the card is printed text in French that reads 'SALONIQUE – Costume turc.' There is a faint handwritten letter 'F' on the upper right side, and a modern watermark with a website URL appears near the bottom.
